title: Atrinik
description: Atrinik is a human-made open-source role-playing world whose software is maintained and rebuilt primarily through Codex-driven agentic workflows, with human code contributions welcome.

identity.heading: A human-made world, powered by agent-driven software.
identity.gameContent: People create Atrinik's maps, pixel art, music, sound effects, quests, dialogue, and lore. Generative AI is not used to create or modify shipped game content.
identity.software: Software is developed primarily through Codex-driven agentic workflows under human direction, review, provenance, and validation. Direct human code contributions are welcome under the same gates.
identity.websiteMediaException: Until the temporary concept artwork is replaced, this game-content policy does not describe every image on atrinik.org; the four generated website images remain explicitly recorded and credited.
